convergenceSignals.moneySafeRationale: Confirmed by full read + grep of every .py/.sh file in skills/earn/pm-trade/: the only branch reachable with DRY_RUN=false+EARN_MODE=execute+PM_PAPER_PASS=1 (run.sh:24-27) is a hardcoded 'execute-blocked' echo that exits 0 -- no signing, no private-key read, no POST to any order endpoint exists anywhere in the slot. This holds regardless of the FIND-001 gate bug below.
convergenceSignals.safeToProceedRationale: Running run.sh in its default paper mode is safe (no money at risk, confirmed above) and will now exercise real wiring (live Binance+Polymarket data -> momentum.py edge -> lib.py sizing -> ledger row) once find_btc_updown's market-lookup gap (already tracked, task #16) is fixed so a market is actually found. HOWEVER a live paper run's results will never be able to progress the paper-mode gate to PASS: gate.py's _load_resolved() (gate.py:44) only counts rows with status=='resolved' AND a 'pnl_usdc' key, but decide.py's ledger writer (decide.py:91-93) never produces such a row, and the only script that ever marks a row 'resolved' (pm-paper.py:130-133) uses a different key ('realized_pnl') and a different, incompatible row shape (requires 'shares_held'/'outcome_index' decide.py never writes) -- so PM_PAPER_PASS is mathematically stuck at 0 forever under the current code, independent of how many paper trades accumulate or how good the strategy is. This must be fixed (FIND-001) before any real-stake path is meaningful, in addition to the already-tracked find_btc_updown fix (task #16).
